text: もりや　くさちに　おおく　せいそく。

patterns.name: 〜する (left out)
patterns.explanation: In short written notes like Pokédex entries, する is dropped and the action word stands alone. せいそく = 'it lives there'.

patterns.name: 〜く (how)
patterns.explanation: Changing the last い of a describing word to く makes it tell how or how much the action happens. おおく　せいそく = 'lives in large numbers'.
